description.text: One of the two seventh expansions of the Sword & Shield series, released together with Blue Sky Stream in July 2021. The two brought the Dragon type into the Sword & Shield series: its Dragon Pokémon have no Weakness and attacks that take Energy of two types. Skyscraping Perfection holds the Single Strike cards, led by Duraludon VMAX, whose Ability shields it from the attacks of Pokémon with Special Energy attached. Noivern V, Golurk V, Hydreigon, Altaria and Drampa join it, with Raihan, a Supporter that attaches a basic Energy from the discard pile and takes any card from the deck after one of its player's Pokémon was Knocked Out, and the Stadium Crystal Cave, which heals Metal and Dragon Pokémon. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 67, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters with a second Duraludon VMAX drawn as a full scene, and gold Ultra Rare Cresselia, Full Face Guard, Crystal Cave and Metal Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Evolving Skies in August 2021 and Fusion Strike in November 2021.
